theme.title: From Tip to Buzzer
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The 2015–16 Warriors opened the season with how many straight wins?
questions.note: 24 in a row before their first loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors began the 2015–16 season by winning their first 24 games,

funFacts.text: Assistant Luke Walton coached Golden State's opening stretch while Steve Kerr recovered from back surgery.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors opened the regular season on October 27 with assistant coach Luke Walton coaching

funFacts.text: Milwaukee finally ended the opening streak, with the Bucks handing Golden State its first loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The winning streak to start the season ended at 24 games when they were beaten by the Milwaukee Bucks

funFacts.text: Draymond Green produced a rare five-by-five stat line in the double-overtime win at Boston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: During this game Draymond Green recorded a five-by-five game

questions.prompt: How many games did Seattle win in January of its 1979 championship season?
questions.note: Ten wins in January, powered by strong road form.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: January: 10–4 (home: 3–3; road: 7–1)

funFacts.text: Seattle won seven January road games and lost only once away from home.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: January: 10–4 (home: 3–3; road: 7–1)

funFacts.text: The Sonics won a tight January game at Washington, a preview of the Finals matchup.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: January 23 @ Washington W 103–100

funFacts.text: The Sonics also won a tight January game on the road in Phoenix.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: January 11 @ Phoenix W 109–106

questions.prompt: By how many points did Portland win Game 4 of the 1977 Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 32 point win being the largest margin of victory in a Finals game 4 until 2024

funFacts.text: Julius Erving led Philadelphia with 24 points in its Game 4 defeat.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Erving 24

funFacts.text: Maurice Lucas's Blazers had lost the opening pair in Philadelphia before evening the series at home.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The series started 2–0 in favor of Philadelphia, but Portland rebounded in the next four games

funFacts.text: Walton contributed 13 rebounds despite foul trouble in that victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rebs: Walton 13

questions.prompt: Draymond Green led all scorers in Game 7 of the 2016 Finals. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 32, more than anyone else that night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Draymond Green put up his best performance of the Finals, leading all scorers with 32 points,

funFacts.text: Green shot an outstanding six of eight from beyond the arc in the final game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including 6-of-8 from three-point range

funFacts.text: His stat line also included 15 rebounds and nine assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: along with 15 rebounds and nine assists

funFacts.text: Kyrie Irving added 26 points for Cleveland during the decisive game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kyrie Irving added 26 points for Cleveland

questions.prompt: From November 1996 to April 1997, Reggie Miller made a three in how many straight games?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Miller made a three-pointer in 68 consecutive games from November 15, 1996, to April 6, 1997.

funFacts.text: Miller remained with Indiana for his entire playing career, an increasingly rare feat for a long-tenured star.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: played his entire 18-year career in the National Basketball Association (NBA) with the Indiana Pacers

funFacts.text: He eventually joined the exclusive fifty-forty-ninety shooting club, combining accuracy at the line and from the field.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He is one of only nine players to join the 50–40–90 club

funFacts.text: Miller's career three-pointer record eventually passed first to Ray Allen, then to Stephen Curry.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His record was later broken by Ray Allen, who was later surpassed by Stephen Curry
